name: Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Help with park clean-up, yearly special events, program help and youth sports coaching. Planting flowers and cleaning up debris and leaves are listed park jobs.
who_can_apply: Individuals and groups. People under 18 need a parent or legal guardian to sign the forms. No minimum age is listed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Agreement Form. A parent signs it if you are under 18. Email it to efallon@waukeganparks.org. Phone: Elizabeth Fallon, (847) 782-3626.
notes: Park projects: contact Bryant Brown. Bryant is the Park Services Supervisor. The phone is 847-360-4756. Read the Volunteer Requirements and Expectations document before you start.
